title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement:
What is the value of the product of the \(9\) factors below?

\[ \begin{aligned} &\left(1 - \tfrac12\right)\left(1 - \tfrac13\right)\left(1 - \tfrac14\right) \cdots \\ &\quad {}\cdot \left(1 - \tfrac{1}{10}\right) \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Each factor \(1 - \dfrac1k\) equals \(\dfrac{k-1}{k},\) so the product is

\[\dfrac12 \cdot \dfrac23 \cdot \dfrac34 \cdots \dfrac{9}{10}.\]

Every numerator cancels the previous denominator, leaving \(\dfrac{1}{10}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Write the product as \(\dfrac12 \cdot \dfrac23 \cdot \dfrac34 \cdots \dfrac{9}{10}\) and watch consecutive terms cancel
